node_definition.done_when: First reproduce, at the base revision, in a new tests/test_a_rollback_keeps_its_cause.py: force the step inside the dispatch guard in reckon/crew/dispatch.py that follows the pointer write to raise a named error, and make the worktree removal in the rollback raise as well; record which error dispatch surfaces. Separately, write a roster ledger whose only uncommitted change is a session capture and attempt a registration through reckon/ledger.py. Record both base outcomes in the manifest before changing code; a case that no longer reproduces at base keeps its test as the deliverable and says so. Then make the rollback keep the original: the surfaced exception is the one that started the rollback, with any rollback failure attached as context and printed, never substituted for it; and a capture-only change to the roster no longer counts as an uncommitted member registration, while a real member change still does. The test asserts the surfaced error names the registration or launch step and not the worktree, that the rollback's own failure is still visible on it, that a capture-only ledger admits a registration, and that a real uncommitted member change is still refused. The named negative control (restore the base rollback so the removal error replaces the original) reddens the first case. The gate is tests/test_a_rollback_keeps_its_cause.py, tests/test_roster_write_commits.py and tests/test_ledger.py, run at base and at head; the whole-suite measurement runs as a separate node at merge. Each arm is recorded as JSON carrying completed true and a literal command with absolute paths and no angle-bracket placeholder; each log names its revision on the first line and ends with a bare line reading EXIT= followed by the exit code. The head arm adds no failure id; any added id means status blocked, naming each id. ruff check and ruff format --check over the changed paths report no finding the base did not. Basetemps and scratch trees go under /tmp in a directory named for this run and are deleted before status complete, printed and listed in artifacts. An evidence fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/a-review-dies-where-nobody-is-looking/a-rollback-keeps-its-cause.html records the base outcomes and the change. The turn ends once the manifest reads complete or blocked.
node_definition.goal: A dispatch whose registration or launch raises after the run's pointer and worktree exist reports that original error, not an error its own rollback raised; and a roster ledger whose only uncommitted change is a session capture does not block a member registration.
